newsitem.title: UK: UK will not rejoin exchange rate mechanism - Major.
newsitem.headline: UK will not rejoin exchange rate mechanism - Major.

text.p: BIRMINGHAM, England, April 8 - Prime Minister John Major reaffirmed on Tuesday that Britain would not rejoin the European Union's exchange rate mechanism.
Major was responding at a news conference to a question about the level of sterling. He declined to say what changes, if any, he would make to fiscal and monetary policy to curb sterling's rise.
"You can remove any thought from your mind that we will re-enter the exchange rate mechanism. That is emphatically not the case," Major said.
